items.definition:
a method of voice production used by male singers to sing notes higher than their normal range
He sang the high notes in a clear falsetto.

a player positioned on the wing in certain sports, or a military unit on the side
The rugby team's flanker made a crucial tackle.

a type of screw with a flat top, or a type of fish
He used a flathead screwdriver to remove the plate.

the person or thing that is leading in a race or competition
She is considered the frontrunner in the upcoming election.

a vivid purplish-red color, or a type of flowering plant
Her dress was a striking shade of fuchsia.

a town hall or a building used by a guild
The ancient guildhall stood proudly in the city center.

the commercial transport of goods
The company specializes in heavy haulage across the country.

an animal that feeds on plants
Deer are herbivores, primarily eating leaves and grass.

a fictional space-time continuum allowing faster-than-light travel
The spaceship jumped into hyperspace, disappearing from view.

a person who owns or manages an inn
The innkeeper welcomed the weary travelers with a warm meal.

the quality of being inadequate or insufficient
The patient suffered from heart insufficiency.

the first action or person in a sequence
He hit a leadoff single in the first inning.

a mythical mischievous dwarf in Irish folklore
According to legend, a leprechaun hides a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.

a scene of uproar and confusion
The office was a madhouse before the deadline.

a person who marches, especially as part of a protest or demonstration
The marchers carried signs advocating for peace.

Middle East
Current events in the Mideast are often complex.

a type of plant or a cocktail
She enjoyed a mimosa with her Sunday brunch.

a railway system with a single rail
The theme park has a monorail that transports visitors.

a large vehicle or craft from which smaller ones are launched
The smaller drones returned to the mothership after completing their reconnaissance.

a small person or child; a character from 'The Wizard of Oz'
The little munchkin giggled as he chased the ball.

the use of peaceful means, not force, to bring about change
Martin Luther King Jr. was a strong advocate for nonviolence.

a natural earthy pigment, typically reddish-yellow
The ancient cave paintings were done in shades of red and ochre.

a large ape with reddish-brown hair
The orang swung gracefully through the trees.

a noticeably rapid, strong, or irregular heartbeat
She felt a sudden palpitation in her chest.

a person who brings about peace
She always tried to be the peacemaker in family arguments.

a semiaquatic egg-laying mammal native to eastern Australia
The platypus is one of the few venomous mammals.

a person who plays pranks
The prankster hid the keys as a joke.

a display of data from a computer or other device
The digital readout showed the temperature was 25 degrees Celsius.

an official order laying claim to the use of property or materials
We need to submit a requisition for new office supplies.

an unmarried woman, typically an older woman beyond the usual age for marriage
In many old novels, the spinster aunt plays a significant role.

the process of making something stable
The government is working on the stabilisation of the economy.

a secondary plot in a story
The novel had an interesting subplot involving the detective's personal life.

a device that increases the power of an engine
The car's engine was fitted with a powerful supercharger.

a high-performance sports vehicle or category of sport
He bought a new supersport motorcycle.

the act of following someone; waste material from mining
The detective was engaged in tailing the suspect.

a person or device that taps
The maple syrup tapper collected sap from the trees.

a dangling ornament of threads
The curtain was decorated with a golden tassel.

a dense group of bushes or trees
We pushed our way through the thicket to reach the clearing.

the state of being unconscious
He fell into unconsciousness after hitting his head.

a small or medium-sized macropod native to Australia and New Guinea
We saw a wallaby hopping through the bush.

a comic strip published on the internet
I spend hours reading my favorite webcomic every week.

used to represent words that are too boring or predictable to be worth repeating
He went on and on about his trip, yada yada yada.

a measuring rod a yard long; a standard used for comparison
His performance set the yardstick for future candidates.

a person who assesses losses or claims, especially for an insurance company
The insurance adjuster came to inspect the damage.

the character and atmosphere of a place
The restaurant had a lovely, cozy ambiance.

a winter sport combining cross-country skiing and rifle shooting
The biathlon requires both endurance and precision.

a person whose business is to take bets and pay out winnings
The bookmaker offered odds on the horse race.

a type of bar or restaurant, especially in Spanish-speaking countries
We stopped at the cantina for some tacos and drinks.

a plant of the mint family, known for its stimulating effect on cats
My cat loves to play with toys filled with catnip.

a person who has abandoned their country or cause in favor of an opposing one
The defector provided valuable information to the opposing side.

a regular oval shape
The planet orbits the sun in an elliptical path.

a device or substance that extends or prolongs something
We bought a Wi-Fi extender to improve the signal in the house.

a public festival or celebration
The village held a summer fete to raise money for the church.

a small, pointed beard grown only on the chin
He decided to grow a goatee for a change of look.

a soldier who is a member of a guard
A guardsman stood at attention outside the palace.

a type of shark with a flattened, T-shaped head; the head of a hammer
We saw a hammerhead shark while diving.

a woman who is the head of a school
The headmistress addressed the students in the assembly.

a plant of the cabbage family, with a hot, pungent root
Horseradish sauce is often served with roast beef.

an impressively skillful or successful person
He's a real hotshot in the tech industry.

the action of a spacecraft or rocket leaving the ground
The crowd cheered as the rocket began its liftoff.

the quality of being loud
The loudness of the music was unbearable.

An incorrect understanding or explanation of something
His silence led to a complete misinterpretation of his feelings.

An area of open uncultivated upland, typically covered with heather
We hiked across the vast moorland, enjoying the wild scenery.

A type of flower, typically with white or yellow petals and a trumpet-shaped corona; a person who has excessive admiration of themselves
The garden was filled with fragrant narcissus in early spring.
